description.value:
You've constructed a sophisticated program synchronized with your brain that you can use to remotely control a complex device of your own design. This program and its linked device are collectively called an exocortex. The exocortex is immune to the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Glitching] condition, but the linked device is not.

At 1st level, you choose your exocortex. The exocortexes presented in this book include the following: a drone, a network of mines, or a deployable turret. You can @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Modify] your exocortex in unique ways.
